question: Which Tamil superstar founded the Tamilaga Vettri Kazhagam (TVK) political party in Tamil Nadu and Puducherry on 2 February 2024 with the slogan 'Pirappokkum Ellaa Uyirkkum' (All are equal by birth)?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Vijay**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• **Vijay**, the Tamil superstar, founded the Tamilaga Vettri Kazhagam (TVK) political party.
 
• The political party was established on **2 February 2024**.
 
• The party operates in the regions of **Tamil Nadu and Puducherry**.
 
• The slogan for the party is '**Pirappokkum Ellaa Uyirkkum**' which translates to '**All are equal by birth**'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Vijay** is a highly influential figure in Tamil cinema, known for his extensive fan base and social influence.
 
• Political participation by actors in Tamil Nadu is a common phenomenon, with several film stars having successfully transitioned into politics.
 
• The slogan '**Pirappokkum Ellaa Uyirkkum**' emphasizes equality and social justice, which are important themes in Tamil politics.
 
• Vijay's entry into politics follows the tradition of Tamil film stars like M.G. Ramachandran, Jayalalithaa, and Kamal Haasan, who have also pursued political careers.
 
• The establishment of TVK marks a significant development in Tamil Nadu's political landscape, potentially influencing future electoral outcomes and policies.
